## Purpose
The bar across the top of every page. On the left is where you are (breadcrumb); on the right is everything that is not a page: system status, background runs, notifications, API docs, theme and account.

## Responsibilities
- `AppHeader({collapsed, onToggleCollapsed, onOpenMobile})` holds the collapse and mobile-menu buttons and `Breadcrumb` (from `useNavSections` plus `pageCrumbs`).
- The right side: `HealthIndicator`, `RunsIndicator`, `NotificationsIndicator`, the API docs link, `ThemeToggle`, and `UserMenu` / `WorkspaceSwitcher` (AccountMenus).
- `HeaderBar` is the reusable bar, also used by `AdminShell`.

## Key elements
`AppHeader`, `HeaderBar`, `Breadcrumb`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Uses `components/runs/*Indicator`, `auth/AccountMenus` and `lib/uiConfig`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **What a page says it shows wins in the breadcrumb;** the route names the rest.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
